description: ConoHa VPS lets users manage the resources in their existing ConoHa VPS account from ChatGPT. Users can list their servers and inspect details such as status, IP addresses, and plans; start, stop, and reboot servers; register SSH keypairs; create and manage security groups and security group rules; attach volumes; and delete resources they no longer need. The app connects to the user's own ConoHa account via OAuth 2.1 and operates only on that account's resources. Operations that incur new charges, such as creating or resizing servers and volumes, are intentionally excluded from this app.
